applies: a count above one; count one is not touched and keeps the emulator path

G.meaning: COUNTING. No sale of ours is open; the count governs (0 to N-1).

GC.meaning: COVERED. No sale of ours; foreign sells cover the whole long; no count accrues.

RW.meaning: REFUSED, WAITING. The venue refused a leg of ours; nothing of ours is open. The leg is sent again on a counted quote under the level once the refusal's wait has passed (ruling 15).

FL.meaning: IN FLIGHT. A leg was sent; the venue has not acknowledged it.

WK.meaning: WORKING at the venue, nothing of this leg filled.

PCR.meaning: CANCEL ASKED FOR A RE-PRICE (the chase). The next leg is sent on its acknowledgement.

PCO.meaning: CANCEL ASKED: OUR SALE IS TOO LARGE (the holding shrank, or a foreign sell appeared).

OX.engine_status: any open status, no cancel pending
OX.meaning: HOLDING ENDED, OUR SALE STILL OPEN, no cancel pending (in flight, or its cancel was refused).

FZ.meaning: FROZEN BY A FAULT OF OURS. Nothing is sent before the runner's next start (a named limit).

FZW.engine_status: any open status, no cancel pending
FZW.meaning: FROZEN, and a sale of ours is still open.

FZP.meaning: FROZEN, cancel of our sale asked.

FC.meaning: COVER UNREAD, WAITING. The account's cover or position cannot be read (a cause outside the protector); nothing of ours is open and nothing is sent. It ends when the cover reads again (ruling 17).

FCW.engine_status: any open status, no cancel pending
FCW.meaning: COVER UNREAD, and a sale of ours is still open. It ends when the cover reads again.

FCP.meaning: COVER UNREAD, cancel of our sale asked. It waits for the acknowledgement.

TW.meaning: STOPPED WITH OUR SALE STILL OPEN (its cancel refused, or it could not be asked).

T0.meaning: STOPPED. Nothing of ours is open.

X.meaning: THE HOLDING ENDED. Nothing of ours is open; a later long is a new holding at G, count 0.

QU.meaning: a counted quote UNDER: the venue clock accepts it and its bid is at or under the level

QA.meaning: a counted quote ABOVE the level

NQ.meaning: a step with NO quote (the timer step)

HS.meaning: the holding SHRINKS, not by a fill of our sale

CP.meaning: the owner PLACES or enlarges a sell (any working sell this object did not send)

CL.meaning: a sell of the owner's ENDS or shrinks

MO.meaning: MISMATCH, ours too LARGE: our cancelable sale exceeds the long less foreign sells

HE.meaning: the holding ENDS (flat, short, or a different position under the same instrument)

ST.meaning: STOP of the instrument or of the strategy

FRZ.meaning: the COVER CANNOT BE READ: the account's cover or the position cannot be read in this step (outside)

UFZ.meaning: the COVER READS AGAIN: emitted in every step in which the row is FC, FCW or FCP and the read succeeds

RL.meaning: the owner's hold of the instrument is REMOVED: emitted in every step in which a holding the hold stopped is no longer held (a hold begins as ST; a stop of the node is never released)

oCXL.meaning: OrderCanceled: the acknowledgement in a cancel-asked row, a cancel from elsewhere in any other

oPF.meaning: OrderFilled leaving a remainder (a partial fill)

oFF.meaning: OrderFilled for the whole remaining quantity of the leg

oLF.meaning: a LATE FILL of an EARLIER leg of ours: OrderFilled for a leg already canceled or expired

oINI.meaning: OrderInitialized of our leg: the echo of our own submit, published inside it before the command leaves

oPCN.meaning: OrderPendingCancel of our leg: the echo of our own cancel, published inside it before the command leaves

oOTH.meaning: any other event of our order: the kinds the inventory marks CANNOT OCCUR (Emulated, Released, Triggered, PendingUpdate, ModifyRejected), and any kind the pin's list does not know

predicates.count_complete: this quote is the Nth counted quote under the level since the count was last zero
predicates.formable: the leg can be formed: a positive limit under the price rule (ruling 18), the instrument in the cache, its quantity exactly representable, the client order ID unused
predicates.whole_cover: foreign working sells cover the whole long at this step
predicates.filled_part: the engine reads our sale with a filled quantity above zero
predicates.cancelable: the engine reads our sale ACCEPTED or PARTIALLY_FILLED
predicates.reprice_due: the chase function, called in this counted quote's handler, gives a price under our working leg's limit: the chase interval has passed since this leg's price was set and since a cancel of it was last asked, no cancel of it was refused within the last CUT_FLOOR_SECS (the cut's floor holds the chase too), and the price a tick through this quote's bid, held at the episode's floor until the floor's wait has run, is lower than the leg's limit
predicates.leg_positive: the leg's quantity is above zero. For EVERY leg it is the uncovered quantity read in this step: the long held less every foreign working sell (ruling 19; shares the owner adds while our leg works join at the next leg sent)
predicates.refusal_told: an ALERT that a sale of this holding could not be placed (the venue refused a leg, or a leg could not be formed) has been written and no leg of it has been ACCEPTED or filled since (held by the glue for the holding; a new run starts with none told)
predicates.resend_due: the refusal's wait has passed. After the nth venue's refusal in a row of this holding (since its open leg last filled, in part or whole: ONLY a fill of the open leg starts the row again; a leg we cancel, a cancel by another hand, an expiry, a replacement, an acceptance and a late fill of an earlier leg neither start it again nor add to it; a new holding starts at none) the wait is the chase interval doubled n-1 times and held at REFUSAL_RETRY_MOST_SECS (60 s, a named constant): 5, 10, 20, 40, then 60 s. After a run of refusals, a later episode's second try waits at the carried delay until a fill. After a cancel of a leg of it by another hand the wait is OUTSIDE_CANCEL_WAIT_SECS (60 s, a constant of its own: that minute is the owner's hand, not a refusal). Each wait is counted from the later of the event's own time and its receipt by the node. True when neither happened in this run; judged in this counted quote's handler and never on a timer
predicates.cancel_due: a cancel of this leg may be asked now. EITHER none of ours was refused for it; OR the wait since the last refusal has passed: after the nth refused cancel of the leg the wait is the refused sale's own pace (the chase interval doubled n-1 times, held at REFUSAL_RETRY_MOST_SECS: 5, 10, 20, 40, then 60 s), counted from the later of the refusal's own time and its receipt and never from later than the node's clock when it is judged; OR the cause of this ask is new for the leg: no cancel was yet asked for it because of this event (the stop, the holding's end, our sale larger than the long, a part fill, an acknowledgement at last), so the first ask for each cause is never held by a wait another cause started. A new leg starts at none. Where the refused cancel was the CUT FOR SIZE of a working sale in a live or frozen holding the wait is not the pace but a floor, CUT_FLOOR_SECS (1 s) after that refusal: an oversell cannot wait, and a refusal that persists must not become a cancel at every quote
predicates.cancel_refusal_told: an ALERT that our cancel of this leg was refused has been written (held by the glue for the leg; a new leg starts with none told)
predicates.flight_alert_due: our last command for this leg (its submit, or our cancel of it) has had no answer of any kind for FLIGHT_SECS (60 s, a named constant), and no ALERT has been written for that command's silence; judged in every step of a row that waits for an answer: a counted quote's, or the timer's (ruling 24: a stream of quotes that are not counted must not keep it silent)
predicates.long_remains: a long of this holding is still held after the fill
predicates.faulted: a fault of ours was recorded for this holding in this run: it was in a row frozen by a fault (FZ, FZW, FZP), or a Denied, a voided fill or an event with no column was judged for it (held by the glue for the holding; a new holding starts with none)
predicates.ends_filled: after this Updated the engine reads our sale FILLED: a reconciliation update whose quantity equals a filled quantity above zero (M:1322-1324)

step_order: our order's events, as they arrived

Emulated.reason: the leg is a plain LIMIT sent straight to the venue with no emulation trigger (ruling 1)

Released.reason: the leg is a plain LIMIT sent straight to the venue with no emulation trigger (ruling 1)

Triggered.reason: a plain LIMIT has no trigger price

PendingUpdate.reason: this table never modifies an order: a re-price is a cancel and a new leg (ruling 3)

ModifyRejected.reason: this table never modifies an order: a re-price is a cancel and a new leg (ruling 3)

Filled.reason: oLF when the leg it fills has already ended (canceled or expired); else oPF when the fill leaves a remainder, oFF when it does not

properties_for_step_d.every_fill_counts: a fill of any leg of ours, working or ended, is applied to the shares sold and to the holding read before the mismatch and the holding's end are judged in that step; none is dropped because its leg is not the working one
properties_for_step_d.sold_known_before_the_next_leg: when S2 sizes, every share the venue showed sold on an earlier leg is in the node's count (met at its source, in the adapter; the ran-out path is the named limit until that unit is on main)
properties_for_step_d.no_leg_of_size_zero: no leg of size zero or less is ever sent; a first leg whose size reads zero sends nothing, freezes nothing and alerts nothing
properties_for_step_d.nothing_for_a_whole_cover: nothing is sent for a holding wholly covered by foreign sells; in a row with no sale of ours open, an event that changes the holding's size or the foreign cover re-reads the cover in that step
properties_for_step_d.invalidation_first: what a step sees is applied in step_order; no leg is sent in a step that also saw a stop, the holding's end, a shrink, a foreign sell placed or a freeze
properties_for_step_d.no_timer_transition: the timer's own event (NQ) changes no row, asks no cancel and sends nothing; the one line it may order is the ALERT for a command of ours left without an answer; the floor's wait is started and judged only in the handler of a counted quote under the level. What a timer step SEES beside it is another event: a mismatch (MO), the holding's end (HE), and the stop the caller raises again at every step while a stopped holding's sale is open (ST in TW), each of which may ask a cancel
properties_for_step_d.row_stored_before_actions: the row a transition leads to is stored BEFORE its actions are carried out: the engine publishes Initialized inside our submit and PendingCancel inside our cancel, so the echo of a send meets the in-flight row and the echo of a cancel meets its cancel-asked row, and each does nothing
properties_for_step_d.one_alert_per_holding_until_accepted: a venue's refusal of a leg writes ONE ALERT for the holding; no second ALERT for a refusal of it is written until a leg of it has been accepted, however often the price crosses the level or the leg is refused again; each further refusal is a counted line
properties_for_step_d.resend_no_sooner_than_the_interval: no leg of a holding's sale leaves inside the wait that follows a venue's refusal of one (5, 10, 20, 40, then 60 s for refusals in a row) or a cancel of one by another hand (OUTSIDE_CANCEL_WAIT_SECS, 60 s), from any row; a leg is sent again only on a counted quote under the level, so an hour of standing refusal costs about 63 refused orders; never on a timer step and never on a quote above the level
properties_for_step_d.resend_never_more_than_held: the leg sent again is sized like any leg: the episode's remainder, never more than the uncovered quantity read in that step, and nothing when that is zero
properties_for_step_d.every_leg_steps_down_and_stays_under_the: at every send the leg's limit is at or under the level the holding holds and at or under the limit of the leg it replaces or is sent again for, and never under the chase floor; it is priced from the newest usable quote stored at the send, counted or not
properties_for_step_d.no_leg_rests_above_a_falling_market_in_s: in every reachable state where our working leg's limit is above the newest usable bid, either a re-price becomes due at a counted quote once the chase interval has passed, or the floor's wait is running and will release, or ONE ALERT has said why neither can happen
properties_for_step_d.a_leg_and_its_floor_agree: no leg rests under its episode's floor unless the floor's own rule released it; a leg sent again after a refusal is priced with the episode's floor like any later leg
properties_for_step_d.order_events_are_judged_in_a_step: an order-event handler stores only what its event carries, its own time included; it reads neither the clock nor the cache and neither sends nor cancels. What it stored is judged in the next step (a quote's or the timer's), at its place in step_order and in the order it arrived
properties_for_step_d.every_leg_is_the_whole_uncovered_quantit: every leg is sized from the uncovered quantity read at its send, so shares added while our leg works are in the next leg sent; never more working than is held less foreign sells
properties_for_step_d.an_unanswered_cancel_is_told_once: a cancel of ours with no answer of any kind for FLIGHT_SECS writes ONE ALERT, on a counted quote or a timer step; nothing else changes
properties_for_step_d.the_holdings_end_cancels_a_working_sale: when the holding ends while our sale is working or part filled, the sale is canceled in that step, without waiting for a mismatch of sizes
properties_for_step_d.an_outside_freeze_ends_when_its_cause_en: a holding frozen by the cover's read (FC, FCW, FCP) leaves the freeze when the cover reads again: FC to G at zero or the covered row, FCW to the row its leg's state gives, FCP after its cancel's acknowledgement; a fault of ours (FZ, FZW, FZP) is never ended before the next start
properties_for_step_d.never_more_working_than_held_whatever_th: where the long less foreign sells cannot be computed, our cancelable sale is cut (MO) in the step of the freeze whenever the base's own check says an oversell is possible
properties_for_step_d.a_silent_leg_is_told_once_and_never_rese: a leg with no answer of any kind for FLIGHT_SECS writes ONE ALERT, on a counted quote or a timer step; nothing is sent, canceled or changed for it, and no second sell is ever sent beside it
properties_for_step_d.every_kind_has_a_column: each kind of order event the pin can deliver to a strategy is named to a column by order_event_inventory and by nothing else; a kind the inventory does not know answers as the catch-all

price_rule.from: the newest USABLE quote the quote handler has stored at the send: two-sided, not crossed, with size, accepted by the venue clock; counted or not, inside the gap or not. Pricing is not counting
price_rule.price: a tick through that quote's bid, as the chase function steps
caps: never above the level the holding holds
never above the limit of the leg it replaces or is sent again for: a sale's legs only step down
price_rule.floor: never under the leg's floor. A first leg's floor is the gain lock's applied floor where the lock is armed, and none otherwise. Every later leg of the episode, the next leg after a re-price and the leg sent again after a refusal alike, takes the episode's chase floor as the chase function holds and releases it (ruling 23). No leg rests under its episode's floor unless the floor's own rule released it
price_rule.order: the floor is applied first and the two caps last, so no floor lifts a leg above the level or above the leg before it
price_rule.function: one pure function, leg_limit(stepped, level, previous, floor), in the module; the protector calls it at every send and the enumeration checks it at every send
price_rule.no_usable_quote: where no usable quote is stored at the send, the leg takes the limit of the leg it replaces. The quote in whose handler a cancel was asked is a usable quote and stays the newest one stored until a later one arrives, so a re-price answered before the next quote steps down to that quote's price (ruling 18)
